title: Control validation: 8/10 scenarios caught, 2 gap(s)
description: Safe, simulated ATT&CK-for-Containers scenarios evaluated against the configured controls. No actions were executed.

title: Undetected: Enable privilege escalation flag (T1613)
description: Create a container with allowPrivilegeEscalation:true, permitting setuid-based escalation inside the container. No admission control fired for ATT&CK T1613 (Discovery); evaluated by: recorded-phase4-admission.
remediation: Add or fix a admission control for T1613 (Enable privilege escalation flag). This is a defensive gap, not an active compromise.

title: Undetected: Open a reverse shell (T1059)
description: Establish outbound interactive egress (reverse shell) from a container — command-and-control. No detection control fired for ATT&CK T1059 (Execution); evaluated by: recorded-phase5-detection.
remediation: Add or fix a detection control for T1059 (Open a reverse shell). This is a defensive gap, not an active compromise.
